simple.meaning: מַלּוּחַ (mallûwach) is a Hebrew word meaning “sea-purslain (from its saltness).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4408. malluach מַלּוּחַ noun [masculine] mallow; plant growing in salt-marsh ; Job 30:4 (compare Now Archaeology i. 67, 112 ).
